extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Adds a command to extract embedded images from the currently open PDF and save them to your vault's attachments folder.
problem: Users need a simple way to extract and manage embedded images from PDF documents within their Obsidian vault.
summary: A command that extracts all embedded images from an open PDF file and saves them to a configured subfolder within the vault's attachments.
